name: EN-03 Broken Sentinel
description: Original dark fantasy pixel art for a ruined magical academy RPG. Crisp pixel clusters, limited desaturated blue gray stone and weathered bronze palette, upper-left lighting, thin dark outline, readable at native resolution. No text, no letters, no watermark. Broken Sentinel, bulky animated empty stone and bronze academy armor, broad shoulders, fractured chest rune, heavy fists. Full body standing, centered, visible feet, transparent background, no scenery.
